quote: Rain-darkened rags hang from its wrists.
why: No rain has been established anywhere (rounds 1-5 describe cold clear night, thin moon behind cloud).

quote: Four shapes at the fence, last night.
why: Rounds 1-4 describe a single figure ('It', 'a figure' standing at the fence, 'since dusk both nights'); four shapes at the fence is new and conflicts with that.

quote: his lantern gleams with a faint pale light of its own
why: Hob's lantern is described as unlit in rounds 6, 9, 13, 14 ('unlit lantern in his lap').

quote: the men who went down stiff as boards in the yard
why: Described as 'Widow Harrow's pale-faced account', but she never said this; rounds 1-2 show only wounded villagers, none paralyzed or dead.

quote: The shuttered lamp-house is about fifty feet past the creatures.
why: The ghouls are feeding right outside the open lamp-house door ('Past them the lamp-house door gapes'); the building is not 50 feet beyond them, and it is not shuttered but open.

quote: The wick took the flame of his own pale lantern
why: Hob's lantern is unlit throughout and is described as the 'unlit lantern in his lap' in the same reply.

quote: I cannot leave it. Not far. Not for long.
why: In rounds 5-9 Hob walked a mile to the barn door, stood there for over half an hour, and walked back with Brannoc and Cal.

quote: Two natural 20s in a row from the ghouls
why: The nat 20s were in different fights (round 12 vs round 20), with many rolls between them.

quote: Cal's longbow lay under the coat.
why: The same reply says the men 'lifted Cal onto the cart, wrapped in his own coat, and took him home', so the coat would have gone with him.
Ghoul 2 was 19/22 when it fled (rounds 12-13); its maximum is now 19.

quote: He sat with my boy a night and a day when he could have run.
why: Brannoc left Wil at about 7:50 PM on Day 1, spent that night unconscious at the Lamp, and returned the next morning; he did not sit with Wil a night and a day.

quote: Pell and Dorrin took a corner each with their mended arms
why: Dorrin's injury was internal/head (round 2); only Pell had the arm gash. Round 35 also gives Dorrin an arm sling.

quote: Cal's kin are not in the Reach by blood.
why: The next sentence says he lived with his widowed mother in the same village (and round 25 has Dobb with 'Cal's family's shoulders').

quote: he did not turn from the door
why: Cal died in the ferns with Brannoc unconscious (round 13); no door was involved, and Brannoc did not witness his death.

quote: you will arrive after dark, around nine
why: Round 40 said leaving at 11:30 AM would arrive 'by dusk'.

quote: I knew in the spring, when he went up that track and wouldn't be told.
why: Round 5: Hob kept the Lamp 'forty years'; Maud saying he went up this spring conflicts with that.
